title: ZeroClaw is a Rust rewrite of OpenClaw, The binary is 3MB and launches instantly
description:
ZeroClaw is a Rust rewrite of OpenClaw. The binary is 3MB and launches instantly, compared to a Node.js process that typically sits around 400MB of RAM. Supports 22 AI providers including Claude, OpenAI, and Ollama. Connects to Telegram and Discord out of the box. Filesystem sandboxed with null byte and symlink protection. Three autonomy levels: readonly, supervised, full. Deploy anywhere. Swap anything.

https://github.com/theonlyhennygod/zeroclaw
